fieldNotes.buildingId: Address 168 E Wingo Rd geocoded ROOFTOP onto a large warehouse/manufacturing building in a Byhalia MS logistics park outside Memphis. Confirmed Niagara: a cluster of tall white process silos and water-treatment tanks lines the S/SE building face - the classic bottling-plant signature - matching a web facility note describing the delivery entrance 'adjacent to the large silos'. The plant opened 2018.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The site has a continuous chain-link perimeter fence along E Wingo Rd. The truck entrance at the SE corner is a controlled gated drive with a digital driver check-in sign board. truckGate = true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed multi-window guard booth is visible at the entrance; check-in is handled by a digital sign board / kiosk - classed remoteGs = true, guardShack = false. The kiosk-vs-booth call is medium-confidence from Street View distance.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: A web facility note mentions a separate 'exit gate' with shipping restrooms, implying split entry/exit. Satellite shows one main SE entrance complex, so classed entryExitTogether; the possible separate exit gate is flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors run BOTH the W and E building faces, each densely lined with trailers - combined estimate ~100-120 doors, well into the 50+ band. Exact count low-confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop rows on both the W side (beyond the W dock apron) and the E side - capacity well over 50, band 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically separate dock banks on opposite (W and E) building faces - shipping and receiving run from distinct dock clusters. shipRcvSeparate = true.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated on-site trailer-storage rows flank both long sides of the building.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep entrance drive and large dock aprons on both faces give 3+ truck post-gate stacking room.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide entrance apron leaves room to add an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Byhalia MS logistics park, edge-of-town, bordered by woodland and open ground southeast of Memphis - classed Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property.
